lines.text: Jeremiah son of Hilkiah, a priest in Anathoth, received the word of the LORD starting in the thirteenth year of King Josiah.
The LORD appointed Jeremiah as a prophet to the nations, but Jeremiah said he did not know how to lead.
The LORD touched Jeremiah's mouth, put His words there, and appointed him over nations and kingdoms.
Jeremiah saw an almond branch and a tilting pot, and the LORD said kings from the north would set up their tents at Jerusalem's gates.
The LORD made Jeremiah like a fortified city and promised that his enemies would fight him but never overcome him.
